scenes.narration: ChatGPT writes every answer one piece at a time.
Welcome to FredsDesk, lesson six. In under a minute, you'll know what an LLM really is.
LLM stands for large language model: a huge neural network, trained on text, that predicts what comes next.
scenes.definition: A huge neural network trained on text to predict what comes next.

scenes.narration: You already know a tiny version. Your phone keyboard suggests the next word. An LLM does the same job, but it writes whole answers, and it reads your entire conversation first.
Here's the loop. Your text goes in. The model picks the most likely next piece. That piece is added to the text. Then it runs again, until the answer is finished.
Try it. Given, the capital of France is, the likeliest next piece is Paris. Not because it looked anything up, but because that pattern appeared constantly in its training text.
Quick recap. One: an LLM is a large language model. Two: it predicts the next piece, again and again. Three: it learned its patterns from huge amounts of text.
points: It predicts the next piece, again
Learned from huge amounts of text
